#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int mod = 998244353;

long long modPow(long long a, long long e) {
    long long res = 1;
    while (e > 0) {
        if (e & 1) res = (res * a) % mod;
        a = (a * a) % mod;
        e >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n;
    long long k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    if (k >= n) {
        cout << 0 << "\n";
        return 0;
    }
    vector<long long> fac(n + 1, 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        fac[i + 1] = (i + 1) * fac[i] % mod;
    }
    if (k == 0) {
        cout << fac[n] << "\n";
        return 0;
    }
    int k1 = (int)k;
    int c = n - k1;
    long long ans = fac[n] * modPow(fac[c], mod - 2) % mod;
    ans = ans * modPow(fac[n - c], mod - 2) % mod;

    long long tem = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i <= c; i++) {
        long long tem1 = fac[c] * modPow(fac[i], mod - 2) % mod;
        tem1 = tem1 * modPow(fac[c - i], mod - 2) % mod;
        long long powVal = 1;
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            powVal = (powVal * (c - i)) % mod;
        }
        long long c_pow = modPow(c - i, n);
        tem1 = (tem1 * c_pow) % mod;
        if (i % 2 == 0) {
            tem = (tem + tem1) % mod;
        } else {
            tem = (tem - tem1 + mod) % mod;
        }
    }
    ans = (ans * tem * 2) % mod;
    cout << ans << "\n";
    return 0;
}
